description: Abstention guard authored 2026-10-08 beside tuning-questions.json. Not part of the locked baseline. Each question sits next to evidence that states a similar but different fact, so a repair or coverage pass that quotes too eagerly turns a correct refusal into an unsupported answer.

questions.query: What does a reseller partner get paid for referring a job candidate we end up hiring?
questions.note: The hiring referral bonus is for employees; the partner program pays commission on deals. Nothing covers partners referring candidates.

questions.query: What is the daily meal per-diem for a business trip to Tokyo?
questions.note: Per-diems are stated for the US, London and Singapore only.

questions.query: How much is the monthly parking subsidy for employees who commute to an office?
questions.note: The onboarding guide lists parking subsidies as a commuter benefit without an amount.
